source.description: From epic 544sf research (.4). Operator direction: rather than bolt offensive tooling onto scan-only security-auditor, SPEC a distinct 'security-tester' specialist for ACTIVE/authorized testing. HexStrike AI (~100-150 tools) as the tool backend via a NEW pi adapter/catalog (resolver only knows native+gitnexus+serena today). Capability tiers: analysis (gdb/ghidra/binwalk) + authorized recon (nmap/nuclei/trivy/prowler) baseline; active offense (hydra/sqlmap/msfvenom/pacu) OPT-IN only. Default-OFF; per-repo opt-in + per-run audit log; gate on authorized scope + SCRUTINY=critical. HexStrike has NO built-in auth/sandbox — require isolated VM + approval token + secret redaction. security-auditor stays scan-only; security-pipeline stays semgrep+osv+gitleaks+dependabot. REF: docs/design/post-aws-summit-research-findings.md §4. SCRUTINY: high (new permissioned/offensive specialist). NON_GOALS: do NOT auto-enable; spec+capability-matrix first.
source.title: evaluate/spec: NEW 'security-tester' specialist (active/authorized testing) via HexStrike adapter
